description: We are a team from Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México (UNAM)
summary:
Tharsis is a Mars survival guide disguised as a map. Built on the real USGS MOLA
digital elevation model (463 m/pixel), it scores every location for habitability
from pressure, slope, roughness, subsurface ice, sunlight, temperature, radiation
and dust, then computes a life-support budget for water, power and oxygen and
tells you how many days a crew survives and what runs out first. A planner routes
multi-stop Marswalks with A* over the real terrain, weighs crew size and rover
support, and closes the loop back to the habitat. A 2018-scale dust storm can be
switched on to watch autonomy collapse live. Results are checked against NASA's
real candidate human landing regions, and every number is labeled measured,
derived or assumed.
details:
Project Details

1. Project Details — la pregunta que responde: cuánto vive la tripulación, qué la mata primero y hasta dónde puede caminar y volver.

2. What It Does & How It Works — motor de habitabilidad (8 capas), presupuesto de supervivencia (agua/energía/O₂ y cuello de botella), tormenta de 2018 (116 → 2 W/m², 500 → 30 días), rutas A* con 3 perfiles, travesías multi-parada con 2-opt, Marswalk EVA (DEM fino 32 m/px, MMGIS, pareja, drop-off, aborto, briefing), geología USGS (1.311 unidades + 20 hojas), validación (100% del top-5 son candidatas reales, ~71% top-N) y asistente con tool calling + fallback determinista.

3. Data and provenance — MOLA, SIM 3292, RAD, Odyssey, Cushing, MMGIS, Photojournal, GOES/DONKI; etiquetas medido/derivado/supuesto.

4. Benefits & Impact — usuario: comandante de EVA/científico de misión; PWA offline.

5. Technologies Used — Bun, React 19, TS, Leaflet CRS.Simple, Three.js, A* propio, Python + GDAL/rasterio, Playwright.

6. Creativity & Design Factors — la honestidad como función: procedencia visible, radar explicable, validación mostrada.

7. Considerations and verification + AI disclosure — tests, typecheck, e2e, chequeo de precisión y límites declarados.
